hypothesis: Add temporal interaction features on top of the current best BPR+history+multitask setup by switching temporal from none to hour_plus_dow. In within-user ranking, raw user terms do not help, but time-of-day/day-of-week can help through interactions with item/video/author and history vectors, capturing that the same user may prefer different short-video types at different times. Because the current model already extracts user-specific preference via positive-history pooling and regularizes embeddings via click/like/forward auxiliaries, adding a small amount of temporal context is a low-risk way to refine which candidate should rank highest among a user's logged impressions. This is a narrow neighborhood extension of the best node, with modest capacity increase and little runtime cost, so it has a plausible chance to lift GAUC slightly and maybe nDCG@5 if top-5 ordering depends on session timing.
expected_effect: +0.0008 to +0.0020 primary versus node 6, mainly from a small GAUC gain (better context-conditioned ordering) with roughly flat to slightly improved nDCG@5.
decide_reason: extending global best node 6 (valid primary 0.6035); its neighborhood is not exhausted
